You are a programming expert. 
        You will be provided with a patch used to fix a bug. 
        Based on the commit message and modifications in the patch, you need to analyze the root cause of the bug in detail. 

        Here is the patch content:
        From de47db0cf7f4a9c555ad204e06baa70b50a70d08 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Raed Salem <raeds@nvidia.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Dec 2021 17:49:01 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] net/mlx5e: IPsec: Fix tunnel mode crypto offload for non
 TCP/UDP traffic

IPsec Tunnel mode crypto offload software parser (SWP) setting in data
path currently always set the inner L4 offset regardless of the
encapsulated L4 header type and whether it exists in the first place,
this breaks non TCP/UDP traffic as such.

Set the SWP inner L4 offset only when the IPsec tunnel encapsulated L4
header protocol is TCP/UDP.

While at it fix inner ip protocol read for setting MLX5_ETH_WQE_SWP_INNER_L4_UDP
flag to address the case where the ip header protocol is IPv6.

Fixes: f1267798c980 ("net/mlx5: Fix checksum issue of VXLAN and IPsec crypto offload")
Signed-off-by: Raed Salem <raeds@nvidia.com>
Reviewed-by: Maor Dickman <maord@nvidia.com>
Signed-off-by: Saeed Mahameed <saeedm@nvidia.com>
---
 .../mellanox/mlx5/core/en_accel/ipsec_rxtx.c        | 13 +++++++++++--
 1 file changed, 11 insertions(+), 2 deletions(-)

diff --git a/drivers/net/ethernet/mellanox/mlx5/core/en_accel/ipsec_rxtx.c b/drivers/net/ethernet/mellanox/mlx5/core/en_accel/ipsec_rxtx.c
index 2db9573a3fe6..b56fea142c24 100644
--- a/drivers/net/ethernet/mellanox/mlx5/core/en_accel/ipsec_rxtx.c
+++ b/drivers/net/ethernet/mellanox/mlx5/core/en_accel/ipsec_rxtx.c
@@ -157,11 +157,20 @@ static void mlx5e_ipsec_set_swp(struct sk_buff *skb,
 	/* Tunnel mode */
 	if (mode == XFRM_MODE_TUNNEL) {
 		eseg->swp_inner_l3_offset = skb_inner_network_offset(skb) / 2;
-		eseg->swp_inner_l4_offset = skb_inner_transport_offset(skb) / 2;
 		if (xo->proto == IPPROTO_IPV6)
 			eseg->swp_flags |= MLX5_ETH_WQE_SWP_INNER_L3_IPV6;
-		if (inner_ip_hdr(skb)->protocol == IPPROTO_UDP)
+
+		switch (xo->inner_ipproto) {
+		case IPPROTO_UDP:
 			eseg->swp_flags |= MLX5_ETH_WQE_SWP_INNER_L4_UDP;
+			fallthrough;
+		case IPPROTO_TCP:
+			/* IP | ESP | IP | [TCP | UDP] */
+			eseg->swp_inner_l4_offset = skb_inner_transport_offset(skb) / 2;
+			break;
+		default:
+			break;
+		}
 		return;
 	}
 
-- 
2.25.1


        
        Provide a response strictly in the following format:
        Root cause:<Root cause>

Root cause: The bug was caused by the incorrect handling of the inner Layer 4 (L4) offset in the IPsec tunnel mode crypto offload, which was being set unconditionally regardless of the encapsulated L4 header type. This led to issues with non-TCP/UDP traffic, as the software parser was not correctly identifying when to set the inner L4 offset, resulting in improper processing of packets that did not contain TCP or UDP headers. The patch corrects this by setting the inner L4 offset only when the encapsulated L4 header is either TCP or UDP, thus preventing the misconfiguration for other types of traffic.

Root cause:
The bug was caused by the incorrect handling of the inner Layer 4 (L4) offset in the IPsec tunnel mode crypto offload, which was being set unconditionally regardless of the encapsulated L4 header type. This led to issues with non-TCP/UDP traffic, as the software parser was not correctly identifying when to set the inner L4 offset, resulting in improper processing of packets that did not contain TCP or UDP headers. The patch corrects this by setting the inner L4 offset only when the encapsulated L4 header is either TCP or UDP, thus preventing the misconfiguration for other types of traffic.
